boards.name: Hellowork
boards.notes: Homepage footer lists sites of the Advenn group. Employer page lists a free tier for very small businesses and a monthly subscription. No language switcher found. Partner page linked from employer page was not read.

sources.title: Homepage title

sources.title: Employer pricing

boards.name: Kalibrr
boards.notes: Homepage redirects from http to https/home. Employer page shows a subscription renewal button and links to an employer pricing page, which was not read. No plan prices were quoted from the pages read.

boards.name: Ninacare
boards.notes: Footer names operator Senex Srl at Corso Mazzini 68, Bari, but no country is stated. Employer page states a 14-day free trial only, with no prices. No API or partner page found.

boards.name: Dentalpost
boards.notes: Board redirects with HTTP 301 from dentalpost.com to dentalpost.net. Pricing page states a monthly job posting subscription with add-ons. No headquarters, parent or API information stated on pages read.

sources.title: Homepage headline
sources.quote: Find Jobs on the Largest Dental Employment Job Site in the USA.

boards.name: Remotli
boards.business_model: free posting with optional paid upgrades
boards.notes: Standard posting is free. Optional Featured and Premium upgrades are paid, and the page says pricing may change after a test. Public job search needs no key. Account endpoints need a self-serve key created by a job seeker account.

sources.title: Employer posting page
sources.quote: Post free, or pay to stand out

sources.title: Employer posting FAQ
sources.quote: Featured (CHF 149) and Premium (CHF 299) are optional upgrades, paid by card through Stripe at submission

sources.title: API documentation
sources.quote: The public search needs no key; the account endpoints act as the person whose key they carry.

boards.name: GoGoJobs
boards.notes: Homepage describes itself as a Macau job platform. Employer entrance links to employer.gogojobs.mo, which states no pricing. No language switcher found, only a zh-Hant path.

boards.name: ZZPdock
boards.notes: Site states it is a Dutch website. Footer shows Bomianso with a KvK number, but no parent is stated. Revenue description says it earns from intermediaries, not employers. No language switcher found.
